title: Solar Cycle
definition: Sunspot number shows an approximately 11-year repetition known as the solar cycle.[^1] NOAA calls the peak of sunspot activity solar maximum and the lull solar minimum. A new cycle is considered to have begun when sunspot groups emerge at higher latitudes with the leading-spot magnetic polarities opposite to those of the previous cycle, which means the start of a cycle is recognised from observed groups rather than predicted exactly.[^1]
